translated_title: Trump at the UN: Accuses Mexico of Being the “Epicenter” of Drug Trafficking, but Highlights Progress with Its Government
original_title: Trump en la ONU: acusa a México de ser “epicentro” del narco, pero destaca avances con su gobierno
author: Jim Cason and David Brooks
meta_description: Within an hour, the White House warned the US would act if Mexico does not, and its drug czar vowed to go after politicians tied to cartels.
